support.metaDescription: Official dB Halo help for sound-level readings, spectrum analysis, noise dose, sleep events, permissions, Lifetime Pro and troubleshooting.
support.title: Understand the sound around you
support.intro: dB Halo turns your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch into an approachable sound-level companion. See the current level at a glance, explore live frequency detail, estimate noise exposure and keep useful records—all with on-device processing.
support.featuresTitle: Simple at first glance, detailed when you need it

features.title: Meter and Halo
features.body: Read the current, minimum, average, maximum and peak levels with a clear Halo, weighting choices, LAeq and plain-language context.

features.title: Spectrum, RTA and spectrogram
features.body: Inspect frequency energy through synchronised FFT, octave-band RTA and spectrogram views without breaking the active analysis session.

features.title: Noise dose
features.body: Follow estimated exposure, remaining time and NIOSH or OSHA guidance. The result is informational, not a workplace compliance decision.

features.title: Sleep sound events
features.body: Log recognised event categories, their times and sound levels on the device. Sleep mode does not save raw audio.

features.title: History and exports
features.body: Keep local history and calibration profiles, then create user-requested CSV, PDF, AAC, photo or video outputs when a supported workflow calls for them.

features.title: Watch, widgets and shortcuts
features.body: Use the dedicated Apple Watch experience, glanceable widgets and App Intents while paired devices share only the local data needed for each action.

quickStart: Open Meter and allow microphone access when iOS asks.
Place the device where it will not be covered or rubbing against clothing, then tap Start.
Use the Halo and current dB value for a quick reading; open Spectrum or Dose when you need more detail.
Tap Stop before leaving the workflow, then save the result to History if you want to keep it.
permissions: Microphone access is required for sound measurement and analysis. Raw Meter, Spectrum and Dose audio is processed in memory and not saved.
Photos and videos are accessed only after you choose specific items through the system Photos picker; dB Halo processes those selected items locally.
Health access is optional. With permission, dB Halo writes environmental audio exposure samples and does not read Health data.
support.proBody: Lifetime Pro is a single non-consumable purchase, not a subscription. The App Store shows the localised price before you confirm. To restore an earlier purchase, open dB Halo → Settings → Lifetime Pro → Restore Purchases and use the same Apple Account that bought it.
troubleshooting: No reading: confirm microphone permission in iOS Settings, disconnect an unintended audio route and make sure another app is not occupying the microphone.
Unexpected values: remove any case or obstruction near the microphone, avoid handling noise, select the intended input and review your calibration profile.
Watch or widget looks old: keep the iPhone and Watch paired and nearby, open dB Halo on the iPhone once, then allow the system a moment to refresh.
Purchase not restored: verify that the device is online, use the original Apple Account and run Restore Purchases again from Lifetime Pro.
support.accuracyTitle: An informed estimate, not a certified instrument
support.accuracyBody: Phone and watch microphones vary by model, placement, case, environment and calibration. dB Halo is useful for awareness and personal records, but it is not a certified sound-level meter and does not replace medical advice, hearing assessment, occupational-hygiene monitoring or a legally required workplace instrument.
support.contactBody: Include your device model, iOS or watchOS version, the screen or feature involved and what you expected to happen. Please do not attach private recordings, photos, health information or export files unless they are essential to your request.

privacy.metaDescription: dB Halo privacy policy: no account, adverts, analytics or tracking; audio analysis and records remain on your device unless you explicitly export or email them.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: dB Halo is designed to analyse sound locally and collect as little data as possible. This policy explains exactly what is processed, what may be stored on your device and when information leaves the app only because you direct it.

no-account-ads-analytics-tracking.title: No account, advertising, analytics or tracking
no-account-ads-analytics-tracking.body: dB Halo does not require an account and contains no advertising, analytics, tracking or third-party SDKs. Lumi Studio does not operate a cloud service for dB Halo, does not build a user profile, does not sell personal information and cannot view your on-device measurements or recordings.

live-audio-memory-only.title: Live Meter, Spectrum and Dose audio
live-audio-memory-only.body: When you use Meter, Spectrum, RTA, Spectrogram or Noise Dose, microphone samples are processed in memory on the device to calculate levels, frequency information and exposure estimates. That raw audio is not saved and is not sent to Lumi Studio.

sleep-events-and-explicit-aac.title: Sleep events and explicit AAC recordings
sleep-events-and-explicit-aac.body: Sleep mode stores only recognised event categories, event times and dB values; it does not retain raw sleep audio. An audio file is stored only when you deliberately start an AAC recording. That recording remains local until you delete or export it.

photos-picker-local-processing.title: Photos and videos you choose
photos-picker-local-processing.body: dB Halo uses Apple's PhotosPicker, so it receives only the photos or videos you explicitly select rather than unrestricted access to your library. Selected items are processed locally for supported overlays or exports and are not uploaded by Lumi Studio.

healthkit-write-only.title: HealthKit is write-only
healthkit-write-only.body: If you grant Health permission and choose to export exposure, dB Halo writes environmental audio exposure samples to HealthKit. The app does not read Health data. You can manage permission and written records in the Health app and iOS Settings.

local-history-calibration-trial.title: Local history, calibration and trial state
local-history-calibration-trial.body: Saved measurements, event summaries, calibration profiles, preferences and the local free-use trial ledger are stored in the app's local container. Explicit AAC recordings are also local. They are used only to provide the features you request.

apple-platform-services.title: Apple platform services
apple-platform-services.body: Apple processes Lifetime Pro purchases and restorations through StoreKit; Lumi Studio does not receive your payment-card details. WatchConnectivity exchanges the data needed for dB Halo features with your paired Apple Watch. Widgets and App Intents use the app's shared local container. These system services do not create a Lumi Studio cloud account.

user-directed-files-share.title: Files and sharing you direct
user-directed-files-share.body: CSV, PDF, AAC, photo and video outputs are created only when you request them. The system Files or share interface lets you choose the destination or recipient. dB Halo does not automatically upload those files; after you choose a destination, its provider or recipient controls that copy.

support-email-exception.title: Support email exception
support-email-exception.body: If you email support, your email address, message and attachments are transmitted through the email providers involved and are received by Lumi Studio solely to answer, secure and document the request. Support correspondence is retained only as long as reasonably needed for those purposes or legal obligations, then deleted or archived under those obligations. Do not send sensitive audio, media or health information unless it is necessary.

deletion-and-retention.title: Retention and deletion
deletion-and-retention.body: Delete saved measurements and explicit recordings with the relevant controls in dB Halo. Removing the app deletes the remaining app-container data, subject to normal device backups managed by you and Apple. Delete exported files from the destination you chose, manage Health records in the Health app and remove the Watch app to clear its local companion data. You may ask support to delete support correspondence unless retention is legally required.

children-medical-workplace.title: Children, safety and legal limits
children-medical-workplace.body: dB Halo is not designed to collect personal information from children. Because there is no account, a child or family member using the app remains under the device owner's permission and sharing choices. Readings are informational and are not medical advice, a hearing diagnosis, a certified sound-level measurement or a substitute for occupational-safety rules, trained professionals or required calibrated instruments.

effective-and-updated.title: Policy dates and changes
effective-and-updated.body: This policy is effective and was last updated on 29 August 2026. If dB Halo's data practices change, this page will be updated before the revised practice applies where notice is required.
